_description: Realistic stochastic scenario with balanced portfolio, SS income, and taxes. The first scenario that exercises randomness.
_rationale: 800k savings, balanced portfolio (6.5% mean, 10.5% stddev), 5k/mo retirement spending = 60k/yr. MFJ in Virginia (5.75% state tax). SS at 67 for 30k/yr (before-tax, fixed COLA, subject to 2034 haircut to 23.1k). With 3% inflation, spending inflates to ~108k by age 75 and ~146k by age 85. After tax grossing-up, gross withdrawals grow much faster than the portfolio. Challenging scenario — see expected file for probability range.
name: Balanced Realistic
